description: Historical native LTX 1.4.2 two-stage pipeline using the exact mixed BF16/NVFP4 checkpoint, the nvfp4-prequant loader and NVFP4-aware distilled refinement LoRA fusion, spatial upscaler, and Gemma 3 companion closure. Prequantized companion scales require the resident model loader; CPU/disk block streaming is unsupported. The image builds the pinned native NVFP4 kernels for Spark SM121. The conservative 89 GB peak and 8 GB reserve cover the 49 GB Gemma encoder or 20 GB checkpoint plus 8 GB LoRA, transient fusion and inference buffers; physical Spark acceptance remains required. This historical recipe remains available for reproducibility.
title: LTX-2 19B dev FP4 native pipeline single Spark (superseded)
